integrity: The proof gives a tight lower bound, a unique possible four-position set and a fully exhaustive 256-case finite enumeration with five-position witnesses. The computational certificate is independently regenerated by the standalone checker. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite complete classification for binary order four only; no statement about other orders or alphabets. Novelty may be affected by unindexed equivalent enumerations.
title: Complete optimal-attractor cut spectrum of binary order-four de Bruijn cycles
